name: web-blue-gradient-ai-flight-landing-page-with-tags-and-creator-chips
title: Blue Striped AI Flights Landing Page
whatItIs: A landing page in a presentation on periwinkle with giant ghost lettering, a hero of deep blue vertical stripes with a headline 'Save Time & Money On Every Trip', glassy points and deal cards around a search phone, and a grid of feature cards below, with floating tag pills and creator chips.
whatItMeans: Vertical light stripes give a futuristic stage-light feel, and glass cards make data feel light.
techniques: Frosted glass cards floating at different depths
Highlighted first feature card in cobalt
Circular dashed flight path around the headline
Floating tags and creator chips around the frame
bestFor: Showcasing landing pages on Dribbble-like boards

vocabulary.definition: Vertical bands of light forming a backdrop.
A grid of cards each describing one feature.
A pill showing a designer's avatar and handle.
